newsitem.title: LEBANON: Two Hizbollah fighters killed in Lebanon fighting.
newsitem.headline: Two Hizbollah fighters killed in Lebanon fighting.

text.p: Lebanon's pro-Iranian Hizbollah said two of its fighters were killed on Monday in south Lebanon, where the guerrillas are battling Israeli forces.

"With much honour and pride, the Islamic Resistance announces to its people the martyrdom of two of its knights while carrying out their fighting duties," Hizbollah said in a statement faxed to an international news agency in Beirut.
The statement, which named the guerrillas as Mohsen Abdallah Fneish and Mahmoud Hussein Salman, did not specify how or where they were killed.
"They were martyred while performing their holy struggle duties on July 7, 1997," the statement added.

Sunday saw prolonged fierce clashes between the Israeli army and Hizbollah in southern Lebanon with guerrillas firing rockets into the Jewish state's occupation zone and northern Israel after Israeli warplanes launched three air raids on Hizbollah positions.
Israeli artillery also engaged the guerrillas in duels in which three Lebanese civilians, including two boys, were wounded.
Hizbollah is fighting Israeli troops and their local militia allies in a bid to oust them from the 15-km (nine miles)-wide occupation zone.
